description: This file defines a class `HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_BdoDir` that extends `HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform`. The class provides a method to ensure that `<bdo>` HTML tags have the `dir` attribute set, defaulting to a configured value if not explicitly provided.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_BdoDir
classes.description: A class responsible for ensuring the `dir` attribute is set on `<bdo>` tags during HTML transformation.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Checks if the `dir` attribute is set; if not, it sets it to a default value from the configuration.
